title: US slaps fresh tariffs on China and 60+ economies, effective July 24; China-US reciprocal tariff cut talks accelerate
summary: Washington imposed new 10-12.5% tariffs on 60+ trading partners under Section 301 (forced labour), effective July 24. Separately, Chinese and US trade teams are accelerating consultations on a $30B-each reciprocal tariff cut framework.
why: 关税新一轮落地是全球宏观最大变量，直接压制A股/港股情绪；中美同步谈判tariff互减框架若有进展则是正面催化剂，关注持仓中美国消费股（MCD/WMT/COST）和出口相关标的（小米/美团）。

title: 中共中央政治局7月24日召开会议，强化逆周期调节表述超预期，聚焦扩内需
summary: 政治局会议要求精准有力强化逆周期调节，首次明确充实政策工具箱，聚焦扩内需与改善民生消费，定调下半年经济政策基调；措辞强于预期。
why: 7月政治局会议是年度政策半年检，超预期稳增长表述有望提振港A股消费与互联网板块情绪，利好腾讯、阿里、美团、海底捞、蜜雪等内需消费持仓。

title: 央行7月24日开展5000亿元MLF操作，连续三个月超量续做，净投放1000亿元
summary: 中国人民银行7月24日宣布开展5000亿元1年期MLF操作，较到期量净投放1000亿元，连续三个月超量续做，意在维护银行体系流动性充裕，支撑经济增长。
why: 央行超量MLF注流动性是政策宽松信号，压低银行间利率，有利于A股情绪修复；与政治局会议配合，构成货币+财政双向发力格局，对持仓消费互联网板块偏正面。
source: 人民日报英文 / Xinhua / Bloomberg

title: Wall Street falls sharply July 23: S&P 500 -1.21%, Nasdaq -2.15% as Alphabet -7% and Tesla -14% drag tech
summary: US equities fell broadly on July 23: Dow -0.97% to 51,711.65; S&P 500 -1.21% to 7,408.30; Nasdaq -2.15% to 25,137.69. Sell-off driven by Alphabet's capex shock and Tesla's earnings miss, compounded by a geopolitical oil spike.
why: 美股大幅回调影响港股科技板块开盘情绪；持有谷歌/特斯拉期权的仓位须重估Delta和IV；标普和纳指的回撤也使隐含波动率上行，sell put策略需关注支撑位。

title: China national team steps in to provide 'tech stock put' as state funds spend $9B to halt A-share rout
summary: State-backed funds spent approx $9B halting a tech-led A-share selloff. Regulators, state investors, insurers and asset managers all coordinated — one of Beijing's broadest market stabilisation efforts in years, per Bloomberg July 24.
why: 国家队入市托底科技板块，短期为A股科技股提供下行保护，但高估值AI/半导体股托而不涨的风险仍在；对港股腾讯、阿里等有间接提振情绪作用。

title: Chinese A-share turnover hits 3-month low, drops below 2.2 trillion yuan as tech sentiment cools
summary: Total trading value on Shanghai and Shenzhen fell below 2.2 trillion yuan on July 24 — the lowest since April 13 — as investors shunned tech names ahead of CXMT's landmark IPO and amid new US tariff pressure.
why: 成交量萎缩是情绪疲弱信号，CXMT上市前存量资金观望；成交量低迷往往使期权隐含波动率上升，sell put策略需注意流动性风险。

title: CXMT memory chipmaker set to list July 27 in Asia's biggest IPO of 2026, raising up to $9.8B on Shanghai STAR Board
summary: China's ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) priced its Shanghai STAR Board IPO at 8.66 yuan/share, targeting up to 66.6B yuan ($9.8B). CXMT is the world's 4th-largest DRAM maker with ~7.7% market share and is set to list July 27.
why: CXMT上市是中国半导体自主里程碑，IPO前资金腾挪压制A股科技情绪，上市后将改变中国内存竞争格局，间接利空SK海力士/美光/闪迪等海外内存股。

title: China set to look past Trump's new tariffs before Xi Jinping's confirmed US visit around September 24
summary: Bloomberg reports China may not retaliate against new US tariffs, prioritising Xi Jinping's planned US visit around September 24. Trump confirmed the date; AI flagged as key agenda. US-China trade teams also accelerating $30B reciprocal tariff cut framework.
why: 中美关系短期维稳预期升温，贸易谈判积极信号利好港股/A股出口及科技板块；9月习拜会若顺利落地可能带来关税松动预期，对持仓美股中概（阿里、拼多多）是正面催化剂。

title: Alphabet GOOGL Q2 2026: Revenue +24% to $119.8B, Cloud +82% to $24.8B; stock -7% on capex hike to $195-205B
summary: Alphabet beat Q2 estimates: revenue $119.8B vs $116.9B expected; EPS $9.11. Google Cloud surged 82% to $24.8B, operating income $8.8B. But full-year capex guidance hiked to $195-205B from $180-190B, with 2027 spending flagged higher, driving the stock down ~7%.
why: 谷歌云大幅超预期是AI基础设施景气度确认，但资本开支大幅上调令自由现金流承压，市场担忧AI回报周期拉长；持仓中若有GOOGL期权，IV上行值得关注；也为腾讯云、阿里云竞争格局提供参照。

title: Tesla TSLA Q2 2026: Revenue $28.2B +26% record, but operating income -57%, margin 1.4%, FCF negative; stock -14%
summary: Tesla reported record revenue $28.24B (+26% YoY) and record 480,126 deliveries, but operating income collapsed 57% to $398M (margin 1.4%), EPS $0.33 vs $0.53 expected, free cash flow -$1.09B. Robotaxi now live in 7 metros unsupervised. Stock shed $140B in market cap.
why: 特斯拉利润率大幅压缩是核心隐患，股价大跌使sell put持仓Delta风险暴露；Robotaxi进展正面但变现尚远；14%暴跌推高TSLA期权IV，下周布局sell put需谨慎评估支撑位。

title: Intel INTC Q2 2026: Revenue $16.1B +25% (fastest since 2011), EPS $0.42 vs $0.21 expected; 18A yields 85%; stock +13% after hours
summary: Intel smashed Q2 estimates: revenue $16.1B (+25% YoY) vs $14.42B expected; EPS $0.42 vs $0.21. Data Center & AI up 59% to $6.3B; Foundry up 31% to $5.8B. 18A yields reached 85%. Q3 revenue guide $15.8-16.8B, well above $15.1B consensus.
why: 英特尔基本面超预期扭转，18A良率突破85%并吸引AMD/NVIDIA/OpenAI为外部客户，晶圆代工业务拐点渐清晰；若持有INTC期权，IV急升后考虑是否收获sell put利润。

title: Pop Mart 9992.HK surges +6.87% on World Cup FIFA-themed LABUBU launch; Duan Yongping raises stake to 7.65%
summary: Pop Mart shares closed at HK$168.1 (+6.87%, turnover HK$4.51B) on the launch of MEGA LABUBU FIFA World Cup 26 editions (HK$1,625 each, 1 per person). Investor Duan Yongping also disclosed buying ~10.59M shares at up to HK$150 each (~HK$1.59B), lifting his stake from 6.85% to 7.65%.
why: FIFA世界杯联名是Labubu出圈的里程碑事件，叠加段永平大额增持背书，IP+大资金共振支撑估值；短期股价大涨后IV上升，covered call策略时机可关注；长期品牌全球化验证持续。

title: Xiaomi 1810.HK unveils 'Sky Nomad' EREV SUV series; YU7 cumulative deliveries reach 258,232 units
summary: Xiaomi unveiled 'Sky Nomad' (Pengcheng/澎程), an extended-range EV SUV lineup, broadening its auto portfolio beyond BEV SU7 and YU7. YU7 had 258,232 cumulative deliveries since its June 2025 launch. Xiaomi shares at HK$27.14 as of July 23.
why: 小米以EREV拓展SUV品类，覆盖更广里程焦虑场景，EV业务多元化利于长期盈利性；YU7交付量验证品牌转化力；对持有1810.HK sell put者提供基本面正向支撑。

title: SK Hynix rallies +14% ahead of July 29 earnings; HBM4 mass production targeted Q3 2026; consensus KRW 84.12T revenue
summary: SK Hynix rallied ~14% in Seoul in the days before its July 29 Q2 earnings. Wall Street consensus: KRW 84.12T revenue, KRW 7,544 EPS. HBM4 full-scale mass production expected in Q3 2026. Q1 2026 revenue surged 198% YoY to KRW 52.6T.
why: SK海力士业绩前大涨是市场预期HBM需求持续强劲的体现，7月29日财报是重要催化剂；HBM4量产进展与盈利指引将影响整个AI内存赛道（美光、闪迪）估值定锚。

title: SanDisk SNDK: Goldman Sachs raises PT to $2,200 from $1,200; BiCS10 10th-gen 3D NAND sampling; earnings due Aug 5
summary: Goldman Sachs raised SanDisk's price target to $2,200 from $1,200 (reiterate Buy) ahead of Aug 5 Q4 FY2026 earnings, citing NAND supply tightness. SanDisk also sampling its 10th-gen 3D NAND BiCS10 1Tb TLC with 59% bit density improvement vs BiCS8.
why: 高盛大幅上调目标价反映NAND供需持续偏紧，与SK海力士/美光的AI存储叙事共振；BiCS10技术领先可拓宽利润空间；持有SNDK sell put者8月5日财报前需关注IV变化。

title: Circle CRCL becomes first stablecoin issuer with OCC national trust bank charter; USDC holds 63% of transaction volume
summary: Circle received OCC approval (July 10) to operate as a national trust bank — the first stablecoin issuer with a federal banking charter. USDC accounts for 63% of all stablecoin transaction volumes. Standard Chartered partnership also launched for institutional USDC minting.
why: Circle获得OCC银行牌照是稳定币监管合规里程碑，大幅提升USDC机构信任度；Coinbase+BlackRock的Open USD竞争加压，CRCL股价短期波动加大；持有CRCL期权需关注监管进展与GENIUS Act时间表。

title: Costco COST June sales +10.6% to $29.24B; quarterly dividend $1.47/share payable Aug 7 (record July 24)
summary: Costco reported June net sales of $29.24B (+10.6% YoY). Comparable sales rose 8.8%; digitally enabled sales jumped more than 20%. Board declared quarterly cash dividend of $1.47/share, payable Aug 7, 2026 to shareholders of record on July 24.
why: 好市多月度销售持续强劲，数字化销售超20%增长反映会员粘性；分红记录日即为今日，是短期持仓参考；8月业绩前可观察sell put机会。
